title: B-ROLL: New Jersey Army National Guard deploys rescue Black Hawk to assist North Carolina
description: The New Jersey Army National Guard deployed a UH-60L Black Hawk helicopter with hoist capabilities to assist North Carolina with rescue efforts in the wake of Hurricane Florence, Sept. 17, 2018. The helicopter and crew are from the 1-150th Assault Helicopter Battalion, Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, N.J.
